method: 49 homologous bone bounds-centres initialize a labeled surface ICP. 500 area-weighted samples per bone; target 12000 samples, seeds 123/456. Global uniform scale then regional rigid fits; upper 10 bones, lower 12 bones with pelvic references weighted 4x. No nerve-wise fit. Frozen after checks.
notes: Point-to-sampled-surface metrics are approximate and unidirectional; not clinical error estimates.
The same global scale 0.996913831900823 is used in both integrated regions. Residual region transforms relative to the global fit are rigid.
No spinal geometry is integrated; different spine curvature produces canal overlaps.
Lower registration prioritises pelvis (2000 rather than 500 source samples per coxal); foot paths failing the overlap check are excluded.
